title: Concept: CSP without frame-ancestors
description: A Content-Security-Policy is present but has no frame-ancestors directive, so it constrains scripts and sources yet says nothing about which sites may frame the page. Framing protection has to be stated explicitly because it is not inherited from other directives.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy and are rendered in a browser.
risk: Framing remains unrestricted despite an apparent policy; MEDIUM severity.
